{{Quote|Hmm. You suppose the Empire knows we're here?|Doc, in response to the sound of Razik entering the lab|<ref name="Spoils of War" />}}
'''Razik''' was<ref name="Spoils of War" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. A pale-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|red-orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and short black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in a [[double stripe]] hairstyle, Razik made use of a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and [[Sith apparel|armored robes]] in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] in [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|their attempt]] to drive the Empire off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]<ref name="Spoils of War" /> in [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Razik was stationed in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] during the battle to protect a [[Prototype cloaking device|cloaking device prototype]].<ref name="Spoils of War" />

However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and the [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|raided]] the factory to recover the device. When the pair copied research data from a [[Computer terminal|terminal]] and set off an alarm, Razik and their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] entered the room and attacked the two in an unsuccessful attempt to stop the Hero from reaching the device, resulting in the Imperials' [[Death/Legends|deaths]].<ref name="Spoils of War" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Razik appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Razik appears in the Jedi Knight mission "Spoils of War" on Balmorra, where they attempt to stop the player and Doc from reaching the cloaking device.<ref name="Spoils of War" />
